headline: Binance Addresses Security Incident Following Multi-Billion Crypto Theft
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance faced a major security incident involving a multi-billion dollar breach, with on-chain analysis linking the exploit to a North Korean hacker group.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major security breaches can trigger regulatory scrutiny and impact overall digital asset market confidence.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: The security incident directly concerns Binance's platform and user fund security.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A major security breach involving billions of dollars raised systemic concerns across the cryptocurrency sector.
